extDesc.message: Renting in NYC without a US credit history? See on every listing whether the building accepts Insurent or TheGuarantors.

badgeTipAccepted.message: $BRAND$ covers this building. Click for details.

badgeTipToConfirm.message: Same street number, street name still to confirm. Click for details.

badgeTipNotListed.message: Not on the $BRAND$ list. Click for details.

badgeTipUnknown.message: Could not check $BRAND$. Click to search by hand.

insMatchExact.message: Exact match: the listing address is identical to the Insurent record.

insMatchNormalized.message: Match after normalisation: same address once abbreviations are harmonised (Street=St, East=E, 45th=45).

insMatchHouseOnly.message: Same street number but a different street name. Confirm manually.

insNotListedLine.message: No address with this street number in Insurent's certified building list.

tgByStreeteasy.message: Matched on the StreetEasy building id (most reliable).

tgByAddressLoose.message: Matched on number and street, after normalising abbreviations.

tgCoveredLine.message: This building is on TheGuarantors list.

tgNotListedLine.message: Not on TheGuarantors' covered building list. That list only covers NY and NJ, so check by hand if in doubt.

tgUnknownLine.message: Could not check TheGuarantors. Their public API key may have changed.

footInsurent.message: Public Insurent data (certified buildings). Always confirm with the landlord before committing.

footTg.message: Same source as TheGuarantors' official extension. Always confirm with the landlord before committing.

toastCopiedOpen.message: Address copied: $ADDRESS$. Paste it into the search that just opened.

popupTagline.message: Guarantor badges appear directly on streeteasy.com listings.

legendAccepted.message: The building is on that guarantor's list.

legendToConfirm.message: Same street number, different street name. Confirm by hand.

legendNotListed.message: Not on the list. The landlord may still accept another guarantor.

legendUnknown.message: The check failed. Click the badge to search by hand.

popupTip.message: Click a badge to see why, copy the address and open the official search.

popupDisclaimer.message: Not affiliated with StreetEasy, Zillow, Insurent or TheGuarantors. Always confirm with the landlord.

optIntro.message: These details stay in your browser (chrome.storage.local). Nothing is sent anywhere else.

optNoticeDisabled.message: The “request a tour” feature is switched off for now: the extension only adds guarantor badges. The settings below are kept, but unused until it is switched back on.

phExtra.message: I can provide an employment contract and 12 months of bank statements.

optHintCriteria.message: Your StreetEasy filters (neighbourhood, type of home...) stay yours: the queue starts from the results page you are looking at. Here you only add the guarantor filter and a price / bedroom guard.

legendGuarantors.message: Guarantors accepted in the queue (one is enough)

cbAcceptTg.message: Also accept buildings covered by TheGuarantors, even when Insurent does not cover them

optHintTour.message: What the extension pre-fills in StreetEasy's panel. Your name and email are only filled in when they are empty.

optTzLocal.message: My local time (converted to New York)

cbAddMessage.message: Expand “+ Add a Message” and paste the message there

optSendManual.message: Manual: I review and click “Send request”

optSendAuto.message: Automatic: the extension sends and moves on

optHintAuto.message: In automatic mode a cancellable countdown precedes every send, and the queue stops if a send fails instead of carrying on blindly. Test mode always wins: while it is on, nothing can leave.

cbSafeMode.message: Test mode: disable StreetEasy's “Send request” button (nothing can be sent)

optHintSafe.message: On by default. It lets you run the whole flow on the real site with no risk, and a red banner reminds you on every listing.

hintPhClauses.message: Clauses that disappear when the field is empty (recommended):

tzHintNy.message: Times entered directly in New York time.

tzHintOffset.message: Offset applied: $OFFSET$ h (your local time to New York).
